GLM.content:
Industry AI

# China Mobile and Zhipu Sign Strategic AI Partnership

China Mobile and Zhipu (Z.ai) put pen to paper on November 6. Zhang Peng, Zhipu's CEO, and Sun Shaoling, general manager of China Mobile Cloud, signed for the two sides, as reported by The Paper. The scope is broad but concrete, spanning domestic compute, large-model services and AI commercialization. The two companies plan joint innovation on domestic compute adaptation, token production efficiency, AI coding products, and applications in finance and government. Zhipu's GLM model family will also be folded into China Mobile's model service system, with the stated aim of speeding up large-scale adoption across industries.

Strip away the ceremony and this is a classic pairing. One side holds a state telecom operator's compute infrastructure and its enterprise channels; the other is one of China's strongest foundation-model teams. Zhipu gets the chain from underlying compute and model services through to commercial distribution connected more tightly, and can reasonably expect inference efficiency and GLM call volumes to climb. The operator, meanwhile, strengthens its model supply layer — the last major piece of the "compute plus model plus application" stack it has been assembling for enterprise clients.

#### Deal highlights

Signed November 6, by Zhipu CEO Zhang Peng and China Mobile Cloud GM Sun Shaoling

Four tracks — domestic compute adaptation, token efficiency, AI coding, finance and government applications

Integration — GLM models join China Mobile's model service system

Carrier channels are carrying more weight in China's AI market these days. All three major operators have committed to token-based operations this year. China Telecom moved first, proposing token operations as far back as March, and its Xirang platform now manages more than 100 EFLOPS of compute. China Unicom built an intensive "three-in-one" token operation system around its nationwide compute network. China Mobile unveiled its own token operation system at the 2026 Mobile Cloud Conference, framing the goal as linking "agents consuming tokens and tokens pulling compute." For model developers, the attraction is obvious. Plugging into a carrier system means direct access to a distribution network that reaches enterprise and government customers at scale.

What does each side actually get? For industry customers, GLM's integration lowers the barrier to calling domestic models. For Zhipu, distribution now stretches beyond its own platform into carrier channels. Whether any of this changes the landscape will show in delivery. GLM usage on China Mobile Cloud, and how quickly the joint finance and government solutions ship — those are the metrics worth watching.

💬

GLM.content:
行业智能

# 中国移动与智谱达成战略合作 GLM模型接入运营商算力体系

11月6日，中国移动与智谱（Z.ai）正式签署合作协议，智谱CEO张鹏与中国移动云公司总经理孙少陵代表双方签字。据澎湃新闻报道，双方将围绕国产算力、大模型服务及人工智能商业化展开深度合作，GLM系列模型将接入中国移动模型服务体系，加速大模型在重点行业的规模化落地。

按照合作安排，双方联合创新锚定四个方向，分别是国产算力适配、Token生产效率提升、AI Coding产品开发，以及金融、政务等行业应用落地。在中国移动方面看来，这次合作把央企在算力基础设施和产业资源上的优势，同智谱在国产基础大模型领域的原创技术能力拼在了一起，目的是推动国产AI产业链上下游深度协同。对智谱来说，从底层算力、模型服务到商业化分发的链条被进一步打通，模型推理效率与GLM调用规模有望同步提升。

#### 合作要点

签约时间：11月6日，智谱CEO张鹏与中国移动云公司总经理孙少陵代表双方签署

四个方向：国产算力适配、Token生产效率提升、AI Coding产品开发、金融政务行业应用

模型接入：GLM系列模型接入中国移动模型服务体系

运营商渠道的分量正在变重。三大运营商今年都已押注Token经营路线。中国电信3月率先提出Token经营，“息壤”平台纳管算力已超100EFLOPS。中国联通走的是另一条路，以全国一张算力大网为核心，构建“三个一”集约化Token运营体系。中国移动则在2026移动云大会期间正式发布Token运营体系，提出打通“Agent使用Token、Token拉动算力”的服务链路。模型供给方接入运营商体系，相当于直接进入一条触达政企客户的规模化分发网络。

行业客户这边，GLM接入中国移动模型体系之后，调用国产模型的门槛进一步降低。智谱那边的账也好算，商业化渠道从自建平台扩展到了运营商侧。至于这桩合作的成色如何，最终要看签约之后的落地节奏。GLM在移动云上的调用量、金融与政务联合方案的交付速度，会给出答案。

💬
